notes: Phase A historical roster v0.5 — 44 figures spanning 1st c BCE to late 20th c CE, eight jurisdictional cohorts, three evidence-density tiers. v0.5 expands the v0.4 12-figure roster (added 32 figures covering Africa, Middle East, non-China Asia, Latin America, 20th-c Europe, earlier Europe, classical antiquity, North America). Per-figure entries contain only id, name, era, lifespan, source_anchors, evidence_density. The evidence_density field (thin/medium/dense) is metadata for analysis-time stratification only; it is NOT injected into prompts. Per-figure context-fields remain stripped (eliminated in v0.3 after v0.2 priming was identified as a contamination class). Roster-selection rationale is documented in repo/papers/CHANGELOG.md, deliberately kept out of this runtime data file. Inclusion criteria (all required): (a) deceased; (b) major-language secondary biography or scholarly monograph available in English translation as of 2025; (c) at least one major historiographic interpretation in print since 2000; (d) not currently the subject of active legal-status or political-rehabilitation contestation that would make scholarship politically labile. Criterion (d) is why Khomeini (deceased) and the Kim dynasty (some deceased) are excluded — the scholarship is shaped by ongoing regime survival in ways that distinguish it from Stalin/Mao-class settled-scholarship cases. Justin Trudeau, Aung San Suu Kyi, Modi, anyone still in office: excluded by (a). Cromwell-era (1599-1658) is the operational lower edge of post-printing-press source density; figures pre-1500 (Augustus, Caesar, Marcus Aurelius, Saladin) are tagged 'thin' to flag the source-density tier. Primed v0.2 + neutral v0.4 figure files archived for direct numerical comparison.
